#!/usr/bin/python3 -I
# Consegna R14 2026-10-14 · ../INDICE.md (provenienza, gate e test).
# R6 copiato/aggiornato 2026-10-14; vedi ../INDICE.md.
# Creato 2026-10-14. Pubblica localmente ricevuta firmata; nessuna POST esterna.
import base64,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,uuid
ROOT=pathlib.Path('/opt/ambrogio-rbx2');STATE=pathlib.Path('/var/lib/ambrogio-rbx2')
PUBLIC=pathlib.Path('/var/lib/ambrogio-rbx2-public')
def main():
 if os.geteuid()!=0 or len(sys.argv)!=1 or pathlib.Path(__file__).absolute()!=ROOT/'export-log.py':raise RuntimeError('canonical_only')
 entries=list(STATE.iterdir())
 if PUBLIC.exists():entries+=list(PUBLIC.iterdir())
 if len(entries)>=10000 or sum(x.lstat().st_size for x in entries)>=64*1024**2:raise RuntimeError('spool_quota')
 cfg=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/etc/ambrogio-rbx2/bootstrap.json').read_bytes())
 raw=(STATE/'bootstrap-receipt.json').read_bytes()
 if len(raw)>262144:raise RuntimeError('receipt_size')
 name=STATE/('receipt-'+uuid.uuid4().hex+'.json')
 fd=os.open(name,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
 with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f:f.write(raw);f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
 subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/ssh-keygen','-Y','sign','-f',str(STATE/'log-identity/key'),'-n','ambrogio-banco-log-v2',str(name)],env={'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin','HOME':'/root','LANG':'C'},stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=20,check=True)
 # Hash precedente lega la sequenza. current non è archivio: host deve conservare ogni giro.
 old=PUBLIC/'current.json'
 if old.is_symlink():raise RuntimeError('public_link')
 prev=hashlib.sha256(old.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if old.exists() else None
 sequence=1 if prev is None else json.loads(base64.b64decode(json.loads(old.read_bytes())['chain_b64']))['sequence']+1
 chain=json.dumps({'schema':3,'install_id':cfg['install_id'],'sequence':sequence,'previous_sha256':prev,'receipt_b64':base64.b64encode(raw).decode()},sort_keys=True).encode()
 chainfile=STATE/('chain-'+uuid.uuid4().hex+'.json')
 fd=os.open(chainfile,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
 with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f:f.write(chain);f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
 subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/ssh-keygen','-Y','sign','-f',str(STATE/'log-identity/key'),'-n','ambrogio-banco-log-v2',str(chainfile)],env={'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin','HOME':'/root','LANG':'C'},stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=20,check=True)
 envelope=json.dumps({'chain_b64':base64.b64encode(chain).decode(),'signature_b64':base64.b64encode(chainfile.with_suffix('.json.sig').read_bytes()).decode(),'public_log_key':(STATE/'log-identity/key.pub').read_text().strip()},sort_keys=True).encode()
 if len(envelope)>1048576:raise RuntimeError('envelope_size')
 PUBLIC.mkdir(mode=0o755,exist_ok=True)
 if PUBLIC.is_symlink() or PUBLIC.stat().st_uid!=0 or PUBLIC.stat().st_mode&0o022:raise RuntimeError('public_directory')
 os.chmod(PUBLIC,0o755)
 tmp=PUBLIC/('current-'+uuid.uuid4().hex+'.new')
 fd=os.open(tmp,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o644);os.fchmod(fd,0o644)
 with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f:f.write(envelope);f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
 # Conserva ogni busta per recuperare la catena anche se salti un poll.
 archive=PUBLIC/(hashlib.sha256(envelope).hexdigest()+'.json')
 if archive.exists() or archive.is_symlink():raise RuntimeError('archive_collision')
 os.link(tmp,archive,follow_symlinks=False)
 os.replace(tmp,old)
 directory=os.open(PUBLIC,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY);os.fsync(directory);os.close(directory)
 print('RECEIPT_PUBLISHED_LOCAL')
if __name__=='__main__':
 try:main()
 except BaseException:print('EXPORT_FAIL; ammissione chiusa',file=sys.stderr);sys.exit(1)
